name: Black Nouveau
summary: Black Nouveau is a retrospective term used to describe an interior design aesthetic associated with Black American homes, particularly during the 1990s and early 2000s.
description:
Black Nouveau is a retrospective term used to describe an interior design aesthetic associated with Black American homes, particularly during the 1990s and early 2000s. It is described as being an Afro-Asian fusion style, feauturing combinations of Orientalist -- particularly Chinoiserie and Japonisme -- and Afrocentric designs and motifs.

Black Nouveau is characterized by the colors black and gold, animal and cherry blossom prints, bamboo and lacquered furniture, wall fans, and porcelain or jade decorative pieces. This aesthetic has since seen a minor modern revival, with the name coinage by interior designer Shane V. Charles renewing online interest in exploring, documenting, and recreating this style.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Luxury, exoticism, Orientalism and Afrocentrism, sensuality
